paper.title: A data-driven approach for learning to control computers
paper.claim_type_note: 训练完整 GUI agent（像素+DOM+指令 → 键鼠动作）并在 MiniWoB++ 在线评测；不是单独 grounding 组件或 benchmark。
paper.central_claim: 用 BC 与 RL(V-MPO) 等权重联合训练、以人类同款键鼠接口并使用 ~2.4M 条(≈6300 h)人类演示，单一多任务 agent 在 MiniWoB++ 的 104 个任务上达到 SOTA 和人类水平均值，并显示任务间迁移；主要缺失因素是人类轨迹数据规模。
paper.central_claim_scope: MiniWoB++ 104 个模板化合成网页任务；评测任务即训练任务（每回合随机实例）；单 seed；像素(165x220)+DOM+指令输入；字典文本输入为特权接口；作者“方案可推广到一般计算机控制”为展望，非实验主张。

preliminary_evidence_judgment: Read before seat scores. CC-Net is a full keyboard/mouse agent (pixels + DOM + task-field dictionary in, 10 action types out) trained by equal-weight BC + VMPO on ~2.4M success-filtered human demonstrations of all 104 MiniWoB++ tasks, single seed, hand-tuned. Central claim: SOTA and human-level mean on MiniWoB++, with data size as the 'primary missing factor' and 'cross-task transfer'. Evidence is online (programmatic rewards) but every evaluated task family is a training family, so 'transfer' is multi-task sample efficiency, not held-out transfer. Controls are rich (BC-only/RL-only, data scaling over 3 orders, input/output ablations, multi- vs single-task) but values are mostly figure-only in the fixed text, and the scaling arm co-varies the BC loss weight. Table 3 recomputation: human 0.9345 vs CC-Net 0.9355 over 104 tasks, but excluding moving-items (human latency artefact) human leads 0.942 vs 0.936, so 'human-level mean' is fragile. The operation is an audit of the inferred insufficiency of generic BC+RL (pivot by scaling demonstrations), enabled by a unified human/agent action interface. Prelim ranges: G3 M2-3 X3 Em3 Ec2-3 Eh1-2 Es1 Ecost1-2.

signatures.object: 训练配方：大规模人类演示 BC + 在线 RL 联合训练的单一多任务 policy（替代课程/DOM 专用动作/受限探索）
signatures.information: 输入：165x220 RGB 像素、DOM 元素列表、任务指令、（可选）环境提供的文本字段字典；动作 = 键鼠宏；人类演示含 2.4M 条/104 任务；训练时 RL 用 MiniWoB++ 程序化奖励。
signatures.operation: BC 损失与 V-MPO RL 损失等权重从头联合训练；演示按末奖励<0.5 过滤(~5%) 并裁掉连续>10 的 no-op 步。
signatures.output: 单个 policy（4 输出头：动作类型/光标坐标/键位/字段索引）。
signatures.conditions: 每个任务都有大量人类演示；环境实时、30Hz 采集、agent ~2Hz 观察；奖励为 MiniWoB 脚本奖励。
signatures.feedback: RL：环境脚本奖励；BC：人类动作对数概率。
signatures.selection_rule/data: 演示按成功过滤；无训练期候选-选择-留存循环；BC loss 权重在小数据实验中按 sqrt 缩放。

persistence.reason: 静态训练研究；RL 更新是训练算法本身，不是评测后留存的改动。

later_use.reason: 无跨任务/跨回合留存；评测为同一已训练权重在线运行。

signatures.claimed_effect: 均值与人类持平且大幅超过聚合外部 SotA；数据量是主因。
signatures.failure_boundary: simon-says、terminal 得 0；1/1000 数据时过拟合且无增益；强依赖 DOM。

signatures.object: 接口：与人类相同的键鼠动作空间（含宏）+ 像素 + DOM 的多模态输入
signatures.information: DOM 是特权结构信息；像素也输入；字典为特权文本池，消融后仍可通过高亮拖拽完成表单。
signatures.operation: 动作类型(10类)×光标坐标(两个 51 档离散分布)×键位×字段索引；对照实验替换为 DOM click/emit-text。
signatures.conditions: 任务需要点击/拖拽/高亮，DOM 动作无法表达（canvas、drag）。
signatures.selection_rule/data: 消融比较：去 DOM、去像素、去字典、DOM 动作。
signatures.claimed_effect: 键鼠接口优于 DOM 元素动作，利于利用人类行为数据并更可迁移。
signatures.failure_boundary: 去 DOM 掉 75%（纯像素不足）；DOM 动作变体没有针对性优化（演示与动作集错配）。

signatures.object: 多任务联合训练（104 任务共享一个 agent）
signatures.information: 所有任务均匀采样混合训练。
signatures.operation: 联合训练 vs 每任务单独训练比较“每任务消耗 frame 数”下的性能。
signatures.conditions: 任务共享键鼠接口与视觉/语言结构。
signatures.claimed_effect: 联合训练比单任务更省数据，作为“迁移”证据。
signatures.failure_boundary: 迁移只在训练任务集合内度量，没有留出任务。

gap.author_gap: 先前 MiniWoB++ 工作靠 DOM 专用动作、课程、受限探索；纯 BC+RL 在 MiniWoB 提出时只用 17 小时数据且不到随机策略 +5%，因此被认为需要专门技巧。
gap.checked_gap: 作者描述可由正文核对：先前纯 BC 仅略优于随机、DOM 专用路线（c_dom_prior/c_prior_bc）。本席核对了 Table 3 中 External SotA 聚合：88 个有外部分数任务上聚合 SotA(Augmented) 均值 0.646，而 CC-Net 同任务均值 0.924。但 WGE/DOM-Q-NET/World of Bits 的原文不在本批固定包内，其具体数值与实现条件我只能引用作者转述（author_report），未在原文核对。
lineage: World of Bits(Shi 2017, BC+RL 基线，数据 17h) → WGE(Liu 2018, 工作流引导探索) / DOM-Q-NET(Jia 2019) / Gur 2018-2021 课程 → CC-Net(本文)；之后：WebN-T5(Gur 2022) → WebGUM(2305.11854，同批) / RCI(2303.17491，同批)。

rs_pattern.reason: Primary: the paper's stated contribution is to overturn the field's inference that generic BC+RL is inadequate on MiniWoB (agg:CC-A03, son55:E002, son55:E005) by violating its small-data precondition (400x human data) and demonstrating the new behaviour - the assumption_audit_and_pivot signature (identify assumption -> violate -> demonstrate). Fit partial: no tightness/identifiability certificate and the 'binding constraint' is shown only within one architecture (agg:CC-A07). Supporting: a distinct operation maps humans and agents, and all 104 tasks, into one keyboard/mouse action space and one multimodal policy (agg:CC-A04, agg:CC-A05, son55:E020); fit partial because no held-out task shows a capability only the unified substrate yields. Sub-cards null for both: C01/C05/C11/C19/C28/C29 tactics (security locus, identifiability, bounds) are absent; C18 (manufacture a substrate to borrow a mature pretrained recipe) is absent since CC-Net trains from scratch.
rs_pattern.resolves_problem: scoped: closes 'generic BC+RL cannot do MiniWoB++' for the trained 104 task families (author-reported); does not close generalisation to unseen tasks, pixel-only control or real computers.

tactic_steps_checked.reason: Explicitly challenges inference that generic BC+RL requires special action/curriculum machinery.

claims.text: 主要缺失因素是人类轨迹数据规模

claims.result/denominator: 1/1000 数据过拟合且不优于 RL-only；其后三个数量级持续上升(数值在 Fig 7，文本无表)
claims.counter_note: 单 seed、手工调参；小数据设置未调到最优(作者承认可用 KL)；“主要因素”未与架构因素分离。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在该架构/任务集内，演示量是性能的强预测因子；“唯一/主要”仅限作者观察。
claims.aggregate_note: [agg] The scaling arm co-varies BC loss weight with data size (agg:CC-A07); the curve is not a pure data intervention.

claims.text: BC 与 RL 联合训练缺一不可
claims.baseline/control: BC-only(均值 0.305，本席由 Table 3 重算)、RL-only
claims.result/denominator: BC-only 0.305 vs BC+RL 0.935；RL-only 仅在 Fig 7 虚线
claims.counter_note: 无“先 BC 后 RL”对照(数据未展示)，无法排除另一种组合更优/或更省。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 同数据下 BC-only 远低于联合训练；不能说明联合优于预训练+微调。

claims.text: 存在强的跨任务迁移证据
claims.setting: 联合 104 任务 vs 单任务，按“该任务消耗 frame”对比
claims.selection_vs_test: 全部为训练任务，无任何留出任务/类别
claims.result/denominator: 联合训练更省数据(Fig 5，文本无数值)
claims.counter_note: 这是“多任务训练共享更省样本”而非对未见任务的迁移；也没有 contamination/重叠审计。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 联合训练提高训练任务的样本效率；不是 held-out transfer。

claims.text: 键鼠接口优于/无需 DOM 动作，且更利于迁移到无 DOM 场景
claims.baseline/control: DOM click/emit-text 动作；去字典；去 DOM/去像素
claims.result/denominator: 去 DOM 掉 75%；DOM 动作变体更差；去字典仍能用拖拽复制完成表单
claims.counter_note: “无 DOM 场景更可迁移”是假设，实验显示像素-only 性能很差；DOM 动作变体“没有为之优化”。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在 MiniWoB 上，键鼠接口≥DOM 动作；无 DOM 场景的迁移未验证。

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Live browser episodes scored by MiniWoB++ programmatic rewards. All evaluated task families are training families (new random instances only), so not transfer under EVIDENCE rule 2.
assessment.author_claim: SOTA and human-level mean across MiniWoB++, data size as primary missing factor, strong cross-task transfer, a formula toward general computer control.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported, single seed: one BC+RL keyboard/mouse agent trained on ~2.4M human demonstrations reaches a 104-task MiniWoB++ mean (0.9355) numerically equal to the crowd-human mean (0.9345) and far above aggregated published results on the 88 comparable tasks; within this architecture, demonstration scale and joint BC+RL are strong drivers, and multi-task co-training is more sample-efficient on the trained tasks.
cannot_say: robustly human-level (parity flips without the latency-confounded moving-items task)
held-out task/site transfer (all evaluated tasks were trained)
pixel-only or non-DOM capability (75% drop without DOM)
data is the unique cause (BC weight co-varies; one architecture; one seed)
unresolved: Figure-only values (Fig 3/5/7/8) not visible in the fixed text; directions taken from author prose.
Evaluation episode count per task not stated.
No independent reproduction; all numbers author-reported.
assessment.reproduction_note: Aggregator recomputed Table 3 means only; nothing was run.

G.reason: Specific, sourced bottleneck: original MiniWob BC with 17 h data barely beat random and the field inferred specialised DOM actions/curricula were needed; the paper isolates the residual question (generic BC+RL with a human-compatible interface at scale) and states remaining gaps (human intent, pixel-only, non-DOM). Taskwise comparison to prior work is given. Not 4: neighbour originals are not in the pinned pack and some prior numbers are figure-estimated; 'primary missing factor' is not separated from interface/architecture changes.

M.reason: Human-compatible action interface makes demonstrations usable; success-filtered BC supplies behavioural priors that solve the exploration problem RL alone cannot (book-flight permutations); joint BC+RL is a concrete, testable mechanism with distinguishable predictions (BC-only, RL-only, small-data regimes). Not 4: no pretrain-then-RL alternative, data and interface effects not separated, mechanism argued empirically.

X.reason: Observation/action spaces, architecture, hyperparameters (Table 1), filtering, no-op cleaving, BC:RL weighting, splits and privileged task-field dictionary are reconstructable; failure boundaries (simon-says at ~2 Hz, terminal, DOM reliance) are explicit. Not 4: LSTM not ablated in final config, evaluation episode count and harness equivalence to Selenium unvalidated.

E.measurement.reason: Success is the programmatic MiniWoB++ reward on live episodes with a full per-task table and a same-interface human comparator. Residuals: the human-parity headline hinges on the latency-confounded moving-items task (agg:CC-A01/CC-A02); the external SotA aggregate mixes figure-estimated values and zero-filled tasks; episode counts unstated; no checker audit (E13).

E.causality.reason: Controls address each part of the central claim: BC-only (Table 3, mean 0.305) vs RL-only vs joint; data size over three orders with RL-only reference (1/1000 data gives no gain over RL-only); DOM/pixel/task-field input ablations; DOM-action output ablation; frame-matched multi- vs single-task. Not 4: one seed per condition, scaling co-varies BC weight (agg:CC-A07), no pretrain-then-RL alternative, most ablation values figure-only.

E.holdout.reason: Evaluation tasks are the training tasks with new random instances; the human test split is used only for BC log-likelihood; 'cross-task transfer' is co-training sample efficiency, not held-out tasks; memorisation is argued by permutation counts, not audited. Matches the MiniWoB-scoped claim, but the abstract's transfer/generality wording exceeds it.

E.statistics.reason: One seed per condition (explicit), no intervals or repeated runs; per-task failures (simon-says, terminal) and the 104/88 denominators are reported, and the mean parity margin (0.001) is far inside the unquantified run-to-run variance.

E.cost.reason: Data cost disclosed (2.4M demos, ~6300 h, 77 participants), 2B-frame scaling snapshot, 300-step cap and frame-matched multi-task comparison. Missing accelerator time/cost, inference latency, and budget matching against prior work that used ~400x less data.
